name: Bluesky AppView public API and PLC directory
tier_rationale: Bluesky Social, PBC: an established company with published terms of service, developer guidelines and a privacy policy, operating the public AppView and the PLC directory (A8 trusted). Council P099 cond 2: registry provider bluesky, tier trusted.

reliability.justification: Authoritative for the account records it serves (DID, handle, PLC operations); handles, display names and bios are self-asserted, and a custom-domain handle is verified only when the AppView, resolveHandle and DNS agree.

appview.title: Bluesky AppView XRPC app.bsky.actor.getProfile, com.atproto.identity.resolveHandle and app.bsky.actor.searchActors (keyless)

terms.quote: Registry provider bluesky (Bluesky PBC): tier trusted, terms open (developer guidelines checked 2026-11-26: read-only lookups allowed).

appview.notes: Quote: binding council text (P099 cond 2); research C0231 (verified_live 200). HTTP 400 {'error':'InvalidRequest','message':'Profile not found'} = absent (getProfile) and 'Unable to resolve handle' = no account claims the domain (resolveHandle); any other 400 = invalid identifier (SKIPPED not_applicable). Documented AppView limit about 3000 requests per 5 minutes per IP (rate_per_second 10 at an 80% margin); no rate-limit headers were seen on 200/400 answers (2026-11-26). getAuthorFeed, .well-known/atproto-did and did:web documents are never fetched (P099 cond 1/6). Usernames are PERSONAL_TYPES: personal_data_review before default use (A3 BR8).

plc_audit.title: PLC directory audit log plc.directory/{did:plc}/log/audit (handle and PDS history of a DID)

terms.quote: Registry provider bluesky (Bluesky PBC): tier trusted, terms open (developer guidelines checked 2026-11-26: read-only lookups allowed).

plc_audit.notes: Quote: binding council text (P099 cond 2); research C0243 (verified_live 200). Only syntactically valid did:plc DIDs are sent (did:web is never resolved, P099 cond 6); 404 'DID not registered' = no PLC record. The log is capped at 200 entries and kept only as (handle, PDS endpoint, date) tuples (P099 cond 7): signatures, rotation keys and verification methods are dropped.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G05-1 (module bluesky, P099). The Bluesky image CDN cdn.bsky.app belongs to provider bsky_app (batch p2-G05-2, P114). Cache: profiles and handle resolutions 6 h at module level (handles can be transferred; checked_at is recorded), PLC audit logs 24 h. personal_data_review is still to be recorded (usernames and bsky handles are PERSONAL_TYPES, A3 BR8).
